items.name: Mead (Mug)
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 95
Price  2 gp (gallon),  5 cp (mug); Weight 8 lbs. (gallon), 1/2 lb. (mug)
DescriptionThis alcoholic beverage is made by fermenting honey and water. It may be flavored with spices, fruit, or hops.

items.name: Firearm Bullet
items.description: The ammunition of most one-handed and two-handed firearms, firearm bullets typically take the form of small balls of lead or some other metal. Thirty bullets weigh half a pound.

items.name: Bronze Fleet Cutlass
items.description:
Each Bronze Fleet Cutlass is a testament to the fleet’s ruthless efficiency and disregard for individuality. These weapons are forged from the scraps of defeated ships and prisoners’ shackles, resulting in a haphazard yet functional design. No two Bronze Fleet Cutlasses look the same, but they all reflect the grim legacy of the slave-trading fleet.
The blade is often jagged, with imperfections that hint at its brutal origins, while the hilt may feature chains, manacles, or other relics of captiv

items.name: Alchemical Brass
items.description: On the rare occasions when Alchemists and Blacksmiths collaborate, they are able to create something truly unique. One such creation is an ingot that can be used to reinforce a weapon, making it so powerful that it can even break mountains when it strikes true. It is said that when Alchemical Brass is added to a regular weapon, it increases the weapon's accuracy and increases the chances of striking vital areas, making the strikes even more fatal.

items.name: Whispered Courage Whiskey
items.description: "Drink the blood of heroes."Whispered Courage is aged in barrels made from pines cut from the Stoneheart Massacre Glade.This powerful spirit grants +4 vs fear saves for 1 hour. The bonus is doubled if an ally who also drank the whiskey is threatened within your sight.

items.name: Sextant
items.description:
Price 500 gp; Weight 2 lbs.
Category Adventuring Gear
DescriptionA sextant is used to determine your latitude. Using a sextant with an astrolabe gives you a +4 circumstance bonus on Survival checks made to prevent getting lost.

items.name: Saber of Chelish Authority
items.description:
The Saber of Chelish Authority is issued to naval lieutenants and captains whose performance and loyalty have been deemed exemplary. Though clearly ostentatious with its gilded basket hilt, engraved devil-wing motifs, and lacquered red-black steel blade, its material value is modest. The real worth lies in its deadly craftsmanship and the subtle enchantments laced into the steel by naval artificers of House Thrune.
It is a +1 saber (use stats for a scimitar) designed for fluid combat and visual

items.name: Dragonhide
items.description: From a dragon, enough leather can be harvested to create a decent Half Plate Armor out of it. Depending on the hide used, it will also come with resistance to damage of propriety of the dragon that was slain dragon(Blue, Lightning/ White, Cold/ Red, Fire). Due to the armor not being made of metal, the druid class will be able to wear it without any penalties.

items.name: Corn
items.description: Corn is one of the most farmed grains, as it can be turned into oil and flour. Corn itself is a staple food throughout the realms for all consumers and their livestock. The plant in itself is called Maize and it is usually planted as the warmer seasons begin because it is not resistant to the cold.

items.description: One of the few fruits that is also dried, to have it be edible between seasons. It is also used in various meals, summer salads, jams, juices, and even alcohol after boiling.

items.name: Alchemical Silver
items.description: On the rare occasions when the Blacksmiths and the Alchemists get together, they manage to create an ingot that seems to look liquid but don't be fooled, this specific material is sturdier than the regular silver equipment. When it's supposed to be crafted, the Blacksmith and Alchemist work together to attach the liquid to a steel blade, and once attached it cannot be removed. items.name: Chelish Navy Pattern Heavy Crossbow
items.description: This finely wrought heavy crossbow is standard issue aboard Chelish naval vessels. Featuring burnished brass fittings, a reinforced steel prod, and a hardwood stock lacquered in crimson and black (the colors of House Thrune), it exemplifies both state pride and battlefield efficiency. Despite lacking magical enhancements, it is a weapon of superior construction, built to endure brutal salt-weathered campaigns and still punch through enemy hulls or pierce a pirate captain's throat at 120 feet.

items.name: Crabmeat
items.description: This dish features a cooked piece of game brought in by adventurers. The meats are usually not found on most tavern menus and are for the bravest patrons who are not afraid to experiment.

items.name: Breastplate
items.description:
The Bronze Fleet Marine's Breastplate is a rugged, intimidating piece of armor forged from salvaged metals, such as hull fragments, manacles, and broken ship fittings. Each breastplate is uniquely pieced together, making no two exactly alike, yet all are functional and crafted with the singular goal of survival and dominance in battle. The plates are often engraved with crude symbols of the Bronze Fleet, tally marks, or grim, defiant phrases.
Designed for durability and fearsome appearances, the

items.name: +1 Mithral Scale Mail
items.description:
Scale mail is made up of dozens of small, overlapping metal plates. Similar to both splint mail and banded mail, scalemail has a flexible arrangement of scales in an attempt to avoid hindering the wearer’s mobility, but at the expense of omitting additional protective layers of armor. A suit of scale mail includes gauntlets.
Mithral

items.name: Bronze Fleet Volver
items.description:
The Bronze Fleet Volver is a highly crafted, ornate six-shot revolver favored by officers and slavers within the Bronze Fleet. Its barrel and frame are forged from polished bronze, etched with swirling nautical patterns that echo the waves. Embedded in the side of the chamber is a small, aquamarine gemstone that glints faintly in the light, often mistaken for a magical focus.
The revolver is balanced for expert accuracy and durability, and its elaborate design symbolizes both power and prestige

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: An improved form of leather armor, studded leather armor is covered with dozens of metal protuberances. While these rounded studs offer little defense individually, in the numbers they are arrayed in upon such armor, they help catch lethal edges and channel them away from vital spots. The rigidity caused by the additional metal does, however, result in less mobility than is afforded by a suit of normal leather armor.

items.name: Apricot

items.name: Chelish Marine-Issue Long Gun
items.description:
This finely crafted flintlock long gun is the signature weapon of the Chelish Marines—the stern enforcers of order aboard imperial vessels and the first to spill blood during a boarding action. The rifle features a polished hardwood stock capped with gilded brass fittings and a long, rifled steel barrel designed for maximum stopping power at mid-range. Though not magical, its precision manufacturing and durability elevate it above common firearms.
These weapons are issued only to marines sworn t

items.name: Crucible Steel
items.description: When blacksmiths get access to ancient magic, the forge becomes a sacred place. Here the finest weapons and armor are crafted. The most prized of these metals is crucible steel, which is known for its strength and durability. In times long gone it was said that crucible steel was forged in the fiery depths of the earth, tempered by the heat of a thousand suns. It was so strong that it could hold its edge even against the sharpest of blades. The finest blacksmiths would spend hours, if not days,

items.name: Cold Iron
items.description: This specific iron, found in the most secluded deep mines quite cold to the touch, it is known that for those who venture into the Fey realm, it is a must. Most sylvan creatures damaged or attempting to attack a creature wearing Cold Iron armors seem to be taking an additional 1d4 cold damage.

items.name: Eggthorn
items.description:
The Eggthorn is a gnarled, fist-sized fruit native to the scrublands south of Longacre in southern Cheliax. Named for its vaguely egg-like shape and natural thorny husk, it comes in mottled hues of red, ochre, and blue-green, and has a distinct sharp, herbal scent.

items.name: Mithral
items.description: The rarest metal, provides an otherworldy calming blue glow, making it pleasant to the eyes. The equipment made out of this specific ore is sought after by wealthy nobility, as it is so light that even the poorest of fighters have increased mobility in it making them look better at sparring than they are, also providing a point of their statute to the common folk. items.name: Cloak of Resistance +1
items.description: This garment offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).

items.name: Dorcroast
items.description: Dorcroast, the invigorating cold brew coffee inspired by the triumph over darkness in Ustalav, awakens your senses with a bittersweet symphony. With a delightful spritz of energy, Dorcroast revitalizes your day, infusing it with the indomitable spirit that arises from the genocide of one's enemies. items.name: La Calstroix Bottle
items.description: A bottle of sparkling water from La Calstroix river in Shudderwood.

items.name: Chelish Service Saber
items.description:
The Chelish Service Saber is the standard-issue melee weapon for trusted crew aboard Chelish naval vessels—such as boatswains, veteran navigators, and long-serving able seamen. It strikes a balance between form and function: simple enough to mass-produce for the imperial navy, but elegant enough to signal discipline and readiness.

items.name: Chain Shirt MW
items.description: Covering the torso, this shirt is made up of thousands of interlocking metal rings.

items.name: Blood Caimon Hide
items.description:
Caimon Hide Armor is Buoyant and it bestows no armor check penalty on Swim checks attempted by the wearer. 
It's smooth texture allows for smooth movement through water, granting a small swim-skill bonus.  
It is slightly lighter than conventional hide armor, and allows for greater dexterity. 
All other armor check penalties apply as normal.

items.name: Bronze Fleet Longarm
items.description:
The Bronze Fleet Longarm is a brutal, practical firearm favored by the slave-catching marines of the Bronze Fleet. Known colloquially as the "Iron Reach", these rifles are built for utility, intimidation, and lethality. Constructed from salvaged parts and forged from the remains of defeated ships, they are as much a symbol of fear as a weapon of war. Each rifle is adorned with crude etchings or engraved tally marks, often counting captured or killed targets.

items.name: Chocolate Chip Cookie
items.description: The chocolate chip cookie is a sweet baked treat that is recognized by its buttery flavor and the inclusion of chocolate chips, which can be dark, milk, or white chocolate depending on personal preference. It's a classic favorite for people of all ages, not just young folk, and is often enjoyed with a cold glass of milk or a warm cup of coffee.
